subdomains.name: Defense Subdomain (Protection)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Resistant Touch with Deflection Aura and replace the Protection domain's 1st-, 2nd-, and 7th-level spells.

powers.name: Deflection Aura
powers.summary: Once per day, emit a 20-foot aura for rounds equal to cleric level. Allies within it gain a +2 deflection bonus to AC and CMD.

powers.name: Aura of Protection
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Allies gain a deflection bonus to AC and energy resistance, both improving at higher levels.

subdomains.name: Purity Subdomain (Protection)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Aura of Protection with Purifying Touch and replace the Protection domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 5th-level spells.

powers.name: Resistant Touch
powers.summary: Gain a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws, increasing by +1 every five cleric levels. As a standard action, transfer this bonus to an ally for 1 minute, losing it yourself for that duration. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Purifying Touch
powers.summary: Touch a willing creature and let it attempt a saving throw against every effect currently affecting it; each success ends that effect. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once at 14th and 20th levels.

subdomains.name: Ancestors Subdomain (Repose)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Ward Against Death with Speak With Dead and replace the Repose domain's 4th- and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Gentle Rest
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, stagger a living creature for 1 round; touching an already staggered living creature puts it to sleep for 1 round. Undead are staggered for rounds equal to Wisdom modifier. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Speak With Dead
powers.summary: As a standard action, ask one question of a dead creature as speak with dead; it gains no Will save for differing alignment. Uses per day equal to cleric level.

subdomains.name: Souls Subdomain (Repose)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Gentle Rest with Touch the Spirit World and replace the Repose domain's 3rd-, 6th-, and 9th-level spells.

powers.name: Touch the Spirit World
powers.summary: Touch a weapon to let it deal half damage to incorporeal creatures, or full damage if it is magical, for rounds equal to cleric level. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Ward Against Death
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Living creatures inside are immune to death effects, energy drain, and the effects of negative levels, though existing negative levels are not removed.

subdomains.name: Language Subdomain (Rune)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Spell Rune with Rune Shift and replace the Rune domain's 1st-, 2nd-, 3rd-, and 5th-level spells.

powers.name: Blast Rune
powers.summary: As a standard action, create an invisible rune in an adjacent square that lasts for rounds equal to cleric level or until triggered. The creature entering the square takes 1d6 damage plus 1 per two cleric levels of a chosen energy type. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Rune Shift
powers.summary: As a swift action, move one of your blast runes within 30 feet into any square adjacent to you, including an occupied square.

subdomains.name: Wards Subdomain (Rune)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Spell Rune with Warding Rune and replace the Rune domain's 1st-, 4th-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Blast Rune
powers.summary: As a standard action, create an invisible rune in an adjacent square that lasts for rounds equal to cleric level or until triggered. The creature entering the square takes 1d6 damage plus 1 per two cleric levels of a chosen energy type. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Warding Rune
powers.summary: As an immediate action when a creature triggers your blast rune, force it to save or become unable to attack you for rounds equal to half cleric level, as sanctuary. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once at 14th and 20th levels.
